zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

scope: Internal conformance audit against the tailored standards baseline and meta-meta skill charters for the bounded Northstar Daily static browser demonstrator.
non_claims: No accredited ISO certification is claimed.
No production readiness is claimed because production_surface is false.
No backend, sync, auth, mobile packaging, or regulated-data readiness is claimed.

standards.name: ISO/IEC/IEEE 12207:2017
standards.tailored_obligation: Lifecycle process coverage, implementation, verification, validation, transition/maintenance decisioning.

standards.name: ISO/IEC/IEEE 15289:2019
standards.tailored_obligation: Lifecycle information items carry identity, status, owner, trace, evidence, and review posture.

standards.name: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
standards.tailored_obligation: AI governance controls, human boundaries, accountability, auditability, anti-slop, and evidence discipline.

standards.name: NIST SP 800-218 SSDF 1.1
standards.tailored_obligation: Secure implementation practice, testing, no unreviewed dependency/network surface, and review evidence.

standards.name: OWASP SAMM
standards.tailored_obligation: Governance, design, implementation, verification, and operations tailoring.

standards.name: OMG MDA and UML 2.5.1
standards.tailored_obligation: CIM/PIM/PSM separation where useful, without forcing heavyweight diagrams for a small local static app.

standards.name: CMMI V3.0
standards.tailored_obligation: Managed work, QA, measurement, review, continuous improvement, and closure discipline.

residual_risks.risk: Automated accessibility certification-readiness now passes; external assistive-technology lab certification is future work.
residual_risks.revalidation_trigger: External accessibility certification, public release, mobile packaging, or production hosting.

residual_risks.risk: External accredited certification was not performed.
residual_risks.revalidation_trigger: Any claim of certified compliance or regulated delivery.
